name: io.github.butyavk/tracker-mcp
title: Job-application tracker
description: Your job-application tracker in Excel, CSV or Google Sheets: follow-ups, funnel, confirmed writes

environmentVariables.name: TRACKER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Your tracker: an .xlsx or .csv file, or a Google Sheets URL

environmentVariables.name: TRACKER_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Its config, if not <tracker>.tracker-mcp.toml next to it (written on first start)

environmentVariables.name: TRACKER_BACKUP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where backups and the audit log go (default: backups-tracker-mcp next to the tracker)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Google Sheets only: a service account key, instead of `tracker-mcp auth google`
